name: Defender for Cloud / Defender plan features per subscription
text:
// Adapted from the Defender for Cloud Coverage workbook by Microsoft (https://github.com/microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/Workbooks/Azure%20Security%20Center/Coverage/Coverage.workbook), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/pricings'
| where tolower(id) !contains '/resourcegroups/'
| where tostring(properties.pricingTier) == 'Standard'
| mv-expand Extension = properties.extensions
| project subscriptionId, Plan = name, SubPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan), Feature = tostring(Extension.name), Enabled = tostring(Extension.isEnabled)
| where isnotempty(Feature)
| order by subscriptionId asc, Plan asc, Feature asc
